title: Before the First Mark
description:
A source-pinned account of finite admission and observation, exact first-separation minima, requirement-preserving closure, and history report descent. Includes standalone Lean 4.33.0 proofs, Python replay, and a dependency-free Rust companion. Empirical trial observations, finite computations, universal theorems and declared construction choices have separate scopes.

The manuscript is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Companion code is licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial, except the vendored Genesis Python and Lean sources, which retain Apache 2.0. Historical source records retain their stated licenses. See the included license files and source manifest for scope.
